channel.title: Sample Middle East Feed
channel.description: Temple Mount and Middle East news

item.title: Tensions Rise at Temple Mount as Al-Aqsa Access Restricted
item.description: Israeli police restricted access to the Temple Mount and Al-Aqsa compound in Jerusalem's Old City amid heightened tensions near the holy site.

item.title: Israel and Lebanon Trade Fire Near Border
item.description: Israeli forces and Hezbollah exchanged fire near the Lebanon border as the Middle East conflict escalates in Gaza and the West Bank.

item.title: Western Wall Plaza Reopens in Jerusalem Old City
item.description: The Western Wall plaza in Jerusalem's Old City reopened to worshippers near the Temple Mount holy site after a brief security closure.
